owner_system: The newsletter distribution platform (external, or a suengj-com distribution component) — not this repo.

core_decides: editorial content, verification, and voice fit

constraints.length_hint: short; compressed for scan-reading in an inbox
constraints.front_matter: none — plain body plus minimal metadata, unlike suengj-com's editorial front matter
constraints.citation_style: inline links only, no footnote apparatus
constraints.freshness: tight; newsletter cadence assumes near-term relevance regardless of the content-type profile's own freshness rule

publication_boundary: Whoever owns the newsletter platform's send action controls publication; this repo may never trigger a send.

replaceable.note: Substitutable across newsletter platforms provided the length and citation constraints above hold.
